entries.name: Earth surface area
entries.author: NASA Visualization Technology Applications and Development (VTAD)
entries.license: U.S. public-domain NASA media; NASA usage guidelines apply (not CC0)
entries.note: The whole Earth globe is unfolded with the Equal Earth projection. Equal-sized map patches represent equal surface areas under the listed spherical convention; the full colored footprint equals the listed area, not its bounding rectangle. Existing NASA source UVs and imagery are retained without invented terrain. North follows the source globe; longitude is illustrative, not a navigation grid.
